name: ens_groupcv_seed43_v1
purpose: Independent confirmation of the M0+GBT average (ENS) after its post hoc pass under the revised rule.
M0: frozen M0 B recipe, seed 43. Initialization: torch.manual_seed(43), build legacy OnlineKGMSTCA(26, hidden 64), map raw_encoder.* -> encoder.*, head.* -> head.* (same procedure as the seed-42 anchor). Sampler generator seed 43+11, loader 43+101.
GBT: same 130 window statistics and hyperparameters as feature_groupcv_v1, random_state=1 (affects the internal early-stopping validation split)
ENS: mean of M0 and GBT fault probabilities, threshold 0.5
pass_rule: m0s_stats_branch_v1 rule a-d unchanged; e reported
decision: ENS confirmed if a-d all pass at seed 43. If any fails, ENS stays a post hoc candidate only.
forbidden: changing features, fusion, threshold or rule after seeing results
